ferals.name: Cinderkit
ferals.notes: Known traits: Curious and Territorial. Warning: Teeth. Ember Spit produces a short burst of concentrated flame.
ferals.flavor: A foxlike ember Feral built for quick movement and sudden heat. Small size hides a stubborn survival streak.

ferals.name: Thornmaw
ferals.flavor: A low-slung reptilian hunter armored in thorny plant growth. It turns brush and close terrain into a weapon.

ferals.name: Gravemaw Ursal
ferals.flavor: A gigantic ursine Feral protected by black stone plates, with massive tusks and enough power to make a Thornmaw look like prey.

ferals.name: Blacktooth
ferals.notes: Shadow Prowl. Rending Pounce. Black Fang. Challenge enhancement detected
ferals.flavor: A shadow-stalking predator whose black fangs are often the last thing prey notices. Built to close distance before a target can react.

ferals.name: Stonebuck
ferals.notes: Brace. Ram. Stonehide. Current disposition: Extremely angry
ferals.flavor: A compact horned Feral wrapped in natural stone plating. It prefers meeting problems head-on and usually wins the argument.

ferals.name: Razorwing
ferals.flavor: A metallic-winged flier with cutting edges built into its silhouette. Fast passes make it dangerous in open air.

ferals.name: Gloomhopper
ferals.flavor: A damp-loving amphibian carrying volatile fungal growths. Disturbing one can turn the air itself into a hazard.

ferals.name: Bogjaw
ferals.flavor: A broad-jawed wetland brute that treats mud, water, and anything standing in either as its property.

ferals.name: Bramblehog
ferals.flavor: A bristled woodland forager with roots and thorns worked through its defenses. Usually wary before it becomes violent.

ferals.name: Glimmerwing
ferals.flavor: A small luminous bird Feral whose flashes can reveal, distract, or disorient. Its keen eyes make it an excellent scout.

ferals.name: Gravahound
ferals.flavor: A powerful hound-shaped Feral that bends gravity around movement and impact. Titanblood specimens are dramatically heavier and stronger than their frame suggests.

ferals.name: Scytheclaw
ferals.notes: Cleaving Step, Bone Shear, Scent Lock. Current threat assessment: Fatal
ferals.flavor: An eyeless bone-armored hunter on bladed limbs. Once it locks onto a scent, escape becomes the primary objective.

ferals.name: Shatterwing
ferals.flavor: A hawklike Feral formed in broken stone plates. Dangerous alone and far worse when a flock owns the high ground.

ferals.name: Shatterwing Rook
ferals.notes: Boulder Drop, Shardstorm, and Crushing Dive
ferals.flavor: A huge command-class Shatterwing with black stone armor and enough lift to weaponize boulders.

ferals.name: Bastionhorn
ferals.notes: Bond-influenced evolution of Stonebuck. Retains Brace, Ram, and Stonehide. Unlocks Living Rampart.
ferals.flavor: Stonebuck’s bond-influenced evolution. Fortress-like plates, branching horns, and an instinct to place itself between danger and its pack.

ferals.name: Meadow Strider
ferals.flavor: A long-legged living meadow carrying blue grass across its back. Smaller Ferals may ride and sleep in its miniature ecosystem.

ferals.name: Cinder Drake
ferals.flavor: A horned winged reptile that carries ember heat on the wind. Not a dragon—though the distinction may feel academic at close range.

ferals.name: Roadshell
ferals.flavor: An enormous armored transit Feral capable of carrying passengers while moving with surprising smoothness and speed.

ferals.name: Mendkin
ferals.flavor: A pale multi-limbed healing Feral used in professional treatment. Its touch channels restorative blue light into injuries.

ferals.name: Tinkerlet
ferals.flavor: A tiny metal-attracting troublemaker with a talent for collecting loose objects and placing them exactly where they should not be.

ferals.name: Abysscoil
ferals.notes: Initially recorded unbonded under forced collar control. Known abilities: Pressure Lance, Undertow Coil, Surge Step, Depth Crush.
ferals.flavor: A colossal aquatic serpent with crown-like fins and control over crushing water pressure. Its archive carries evidence of captivity and forced combat.

ferals.name: Shardwing
ferals.notes: Narrow silver insectoid Feral with four crystal wings ending in glass-like blades.
ferals.flavor: A narrow silver insect Feral with four crystal wings ending in glasslike blades. Precision and cutting angles define its attack style.

ferals.name: Voltrake
ferals.notes: Lean black jackal marked by yellow lines with electricity crawling between its teeth.
ferals.flavor: A lean black jackal traced with yellow current. Electricity crawls between its teeth before it commits to a strike.

ferals.name: Stormlynx
ferals.notes: Huge black catlike Feral with pale blue lightning moving beneath its skin.
ferals.flavor: A huge black cat with long ears and pale-blue lightning moving beneath its skin. Built to punish water-aligned opponents.

ferals.name: Prismantis
ferals.notes: Red insect Feral on four bladed legs with broad mirror-like plates used to redirect attacks.
ferals.flavor: A red four-legged mantis Feral protected by broad mirrorlike plates. Its reflective defenses make direct elemental attacks a dangerous gamble.

rules: Protected digital-biological environment housed within the Personal Interface Device.
Bonded Ferals can be transferred into Sanctuary storage.
Sanctuary storage prevents additional environmental harm.
Minimal natural recovery occurs during Sanctuary storage.

trainers.name: Reid
trainers.habitat: Mixed woodland sanctuary with stream access, warm resting stone, and reinforced open ground.
trainers.summary: A shared habitat built around Cinderkit’s preference for warm, sheltered rest and Roxy’s need for space, visibility, and room to guard her pack.

residents.behavior: Frequently rests beneath the trees or near warm stone. Stubborn, curious, and strongly food-motivated.
Positions herself near Cinderkit and Reid, treating the Sanctuary as pack territory.

trainers.name: Evan
trainers.habitat: Stone-lined meadow feeding into a deep-water habitat, giving heavy defenders stable footing and aquatic Ferals enough depth to coil and swim.
trainers.summary: A defensive sanctuary shaped around Evan’s bonded partners: solid ground for his earth guardian and protected deep water for Abysscoil.

residents.behavior: Usually found near the stream or testing his armor against whatever part of the habitat looks hardest to move.
Prefers deep water and open movement. Bond condition is explicitly recorded as Freedom.

abilities.name: Momentum Bank
abilities.description: Passive ability unlocked through the Kinetic Essence. Stores usable momentum under qualifying movement conditions.

abilities.name: Kinetic Surge
abilities.description: Active Kinetic Essence ability that releases stored kinetic force in a concentrated surge.

abilities.name: Vector Control
abilities.description: Bends the direction of motion of a touched object. Early use works best on smaller objects and strains Evan’s muscles and balance when overused.

essences.name: Unknown Essence
essences.description: An unidentified Essence. The System warns that integration before analysis may cause rejection, permanent injury, ability corruption, loss of function, or death.

essences.name: Kinetic Essence
essences.description: The Essence integrated by Reid. It unlocks Momentum Bank and Kinetic Surge.

essences.name: Vector Essence
essences.description: Unbound Essence discovered in an old service chamber. Primary affinity: direction of motion. It lets Evan bend the movement of an object he touches; initial control favors smaller objects and cannot directly control another living body.

quests.name: Survive the First Night
quests.description: The first explicit System quest issued to Reid and Evan.

quests.name: The Hungry Night
objectives: Remain inside the designated challenge region
quests.description: The First Challenge. Predatory Ferals receive temporary enhancements and are drawn toward participant locations.

quests.name: Feral Commons Assistance
quests.description: Return twelve escaped young Tinkerlets to their sleeping den before sunset without injuries, fire, property damage, or uncontrolled predatory Ferals.

quests.name: Greenhaven Combat Trial
quests.description: Team ring-scoring trial using terrain, covered passages, water routes, and registered Ferals.
objectives: Carry rings one at a time

achievements.name: First Bond
achievements.description: Awarded when the first Feral bond is established.

achievements.name: First Bond Synergy
achievements.description: Achievement awarded after a bonded trainer and Feral demonstrate qualifying synergy.

reid.name: Reid
reid.notes: Competitive, impulsive, and increasingly tied to the System through his bonded Ferals and Kinetic Essence.

evan.name: Evan
evan.notes: A cautious tactical trainer whose bonds emphasize protection, stability, and control.

systemInfo.name: Personal Interface
systemInfo.text: Permanently bonded to registered tournament participants.

systemInfo.name: Sanctuary
systemInfo.text: Protected habitat storage accessible through the Personal Interface.

systemInfo.name: Feral Acquisition
systemInfo.text: Known methods include voluntary bonding, battle submission, trapping, quest reward, trade, and other qualifying interactions.

systemInfo.name: Greenhaven Services
systemInfo.text: Lodging, commerce, crafting, Feral care, Essence services, contracts, quests, and tournament facilities.

systemInfo.name: Active Feral Limits
systemInfo.text: Outside sanctioned matches, multiple bonded Ferals may be manifested. Tournament limits depend on rank and event rules.

systemInfo.name: Greenhaven Settlement Protections
systemInfo.text: Unsanctioned participant combat is prohibited inside Greenhaven. Theft, intentional property damage, and unregistered Feral aggression can cause fines, confinement, or tournament penalties.

systemInfo.name: Rank Advancement
systemInfo.text: Tournament Points, ranked performance, regional objectives, contracts, discoveries, and bond development may contribute. Higher ranks unlock regions, active-Feral capacity, services, and tournament stages.

systemInfo.name: Placement Lethal Confirmation
systemInfo.text: Placement matches use lethal confirmation; defeated participants are transferred into Tournament Authority custody. Further status details are restricted.

systemInfo.name: Ascension Audience
systemInfo.text: Master Rank qualifies participants for the Masters Tournament. Masters competitors may earn an Ascension Audience and present a claim before the Sovereign.

feralEvents.description: Growth threshold reached after the Blacktooth fight.

feralEvents.name: Stonebuck evolves into Bastionhorn
feralEvents.description: Bond-influenced evolution. Class advances Common → Bronze; Living Rampart unlocks.

feralEvents.name: Roxy — Titanblood Awakened
feralEvents.description: Roxy’s Titanblood lineage awakens. System scan records Class: Master; level unchanged by lineage awakening; severe exertion and recovery required.

dexMeta.note: The tournament world contains far more Feral species than the Book 1 archive has encountered. The Dex is an observed archive, not a complete species catalog.
